title: WhatsApp Says Russia Has Tried to Block Its Messaging Service
title_zh: WhatsApp 称俄罗斯已试图阻止其消息服务
summary: WhatsApp, which is owned by Meta Platforms Inc., said in a statement on Wednesday it was doing everything it could to keep its more than 100 million Russian users connected.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms Inc. 旗下的 WhatsApp 在周三的一份声明中表示，该公司正在竭尽全力保持 1 亿多俄罗斯用户的联网。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb after jobs surprise puts focus back on Fed's rate path
title_zh: 今日股市：就业意外让人们重新关注美联储的利率路径，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: Markets reacted positively to a strong January jobs report as earnings continue to roll in.
summary_zh: 随着企业盈利持续增长，市场对 1 月份强劲的就业报告做出了积极反应。

title: Wall Street ends muted after strong jobs data lowers rate cut bets
title_zh: 强劲的就业数据降低了降息预期，华尔街收盘低迷
summary: STORY: US stocks were muted on Wednesday, with the Dow ticking down slightly, the S&P 500 unchanged and the Nasdaq nudging lower.The indexes had started the session on a strong note, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq hitting their highest level in more than a week after the closely-...
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周三表现平静，道琼斯指数小幅下跌，标准普尔 500 指数持平，纳斯达克指数微幅走低。各股指开盘走强，标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数在收盘后触及一周多来的最高水平。

title: What is Google's Project Genie?
title_zh: 什么是 Google 的 Project Genie？
summary: Google's (GOOG, GOOGL) Project Genie is making waves in the gaming sector, impacting companies like Unity (U) and Roblox (RBLX).
summary_zh: Google（GOOG、GOOGL）的 Project Genie 正在游戏领域掀起波澜，影响了 Unity (U) 和 Roblox (RBLX) 等公司。

title: AppLovin beats quarterly revenue estimates
title_zh: AppLovin 超出季度收入预期
summary: Marketing platform AppLovin beat market estimates for fourth-quarter sales on Wednesday, boosted by strong demand for its advertising services and artificial-intelligence powered tools.
summary_zh: 营销平台 AppLovin 周三第四季度的销售额超出了市场预期，这得益于其广告服务和人工智能工具的强劲需求。

title: Anthropic to shoulder some costs as data center expansions threaten to raise power bills
title_zh: 由于数据中心扩建可能导致电费上涨，Anthropic 将承担部分成本
summary: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic on Wednesday announced initiatives to limit the impact of data centers on consumer ‌energy prices amid increased investment in power-hungry infrastructure necessary for ‌AI tech.
summary_zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 周三宣布采取举措，限制数据中心对消费者能源价格的影响，同时增加对人工智能技术所需的耗电基础设施的投资。

title: Cisco posts quarterly gross margin below estimates, shares fall
title_zh: 思科公布季度毛利率低于预期，股价下跌
summary: Cisco Systems posted quarterly adjusted gross margin below market estimates on Wednesday, as the networking equipment provider grapples with the ‌fallout of a global memory price increase, sending its shares down 7% in ‌extended trading.
summary_zh: 思科系统公司周三公布的季度调整后毛利率低于市场预期，这家网络设备提供商正在努力应对全球内存价格上涨的影响，导致其股价在盘后交易中下跌 7%。

title: McDonald's sales top forecasts as value push, promotions boost US results for third-straight quarter
title_zh: 麦当劳销售额超过预期，价值推动，促销活动连续第三个季度提振美国业绩
summary: McDonald's reported another quarter of growth on Wednesday as its sales continue to turn around in the US.
summary_zh: 麦当劳周三报告称，随着其在美国的销售继续好转，该公司又实现了一个季度的增长。

title: Meta's Indiana AI data center: 3 key details to know
title_zh: Meta 印第安纳州人工智能数据中心：需要了解的 3 个关键细节
summary: Meta (META) announced plans to build a $10 billion artificial intelligence (AI) data center in Indiana. Meanwhile, Pershing Square (PSHZF) CEO and hedge fund manager Bill Ackman revealed that the firm holds a large stake in Meta.
summary_zh: Meta (META) 宣布计划斥资 100 亿美元在印第安纳州建设一座人工智能 (AI) 数据中心。与此同时，Pershing Square (PSHZF) 首席执行官兼对冲基金经理 Bill Ackman 透露，该公司持有 Meta 的大量股份。
